detect_url.description:
Straiker detect endpoint.
This field is [referenceable](/gateway/entities/vault/#how-do-i-reference-secrets-stored-in-a-vault).

api_key.description:
Straiker integration key.
This field is [referenceable](/gateway/entities/vault/#how-do-i-reference-secrets-stored-in-a-vault).
This field is [encrypted](/gateway/keyring/).

timeout_ms.description: Timeout for a synchronous scoring call, in milliseconds.

fail_closed.description: Reject traffic when Straiker can't be reached. When `false`, traffic passes and the response is stamped `degraded`.

score_request.description: Score the prompt. Turn off on non-inference paths such as `count_tokens`, which carries no system prompt and can be misclassified.

max_body_bytes.description: Skip scoring above this size, in bytes.

upstream_api_key.description:
Model credential the gateway holds, injected on the way out so clients never carry a platform key.
This field is [referenceable](/gateway/entities/vault/#how-do-i-reference-secrets-stored-in-a-vault).
This field is [encrypted](/gateway/keyring/).

upstream_key_header.description: Header that carries the upstream credential. Use `authorization` for OpenAI-style providers.

user_ref.description:
Fallback attribution, used only when no Kong Consumer is resolved.
This field is [referenceable](/gateway/entities/vault/#how-do-i-reference-secrets-stored-in-a-vault).

session_from_body.description: Derive a stable session ID when the client sends no session header.

debug_preamble.description: Log the system-prompt shape to explain client resolution. Prints prompt content to the Kong log, so keep it disabled in production.

client.description: Names the client on a single-application route. Leave unset on a shared gateway.

agent_ref.description: Names one agent. Scope it to a route.

format_hint.description: Only used to resolve an ambiguous `messages` array.

consumer.description: If set, the plugin will activate only for requests where the specified consumer has been authenticated.

consumer_group.description: If set, the plugin will activate only for requests where the specified consumer group has been authenticated.

route.description: If set, the plugin will only activate when receiving requests via the specified route.

service.description: If set, the plugin will only activate when receiving requests via one of the routes belonging to the specified Service.

protocols.description: A list of the request protocols that will trigger this plugin.
